title: 第1442章 让它生它就生第1441章 天啊这是什么神仙日子
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 卢希坐在一旁安静地喝汤，喝完汤后走出太空舱，看着李潇两根食指，小鸡琢米似的打字。
打字速度很慢，每打一个字还要找五笔字根。
他把唐横刀放在李潇的办公桌上，声音冷漠：“你打字速度太慢了，我帮你登记兑换物资名册！”
李潇回头看了一眼卢希，神明身边的抱刀少年。
“你，会打字？”
“排版，打印呢？”
“很简单！”
卢希的养父养母对他很上心，除了请私教教体育外，初高中课程重新补，是一对一教学。
他有属于自己的电脑，打印机……
这些对他来说并不陌生。
李潇让出坐位，卢希坐下，按着文书记录的册子，速度飞快地记录。
他不需要看键盘，啪嗒啪嗒字就打了出来。
速度是李潇的数倍。
李潇见他操作得比自己还要利索，索性就让他去干了。
见到这一幕，叶苜苜收回目光。
原本以为会有一场噩梦般对决，没想到齐国都城这么轻松拿下，觉得像在做梦！
叶苜苜把在天台上值守的所有将士都喊过来，大家一起吃饭。
叶苜苜吃得不多，小半碗后，把餐桌让给将士们。
大家很少能吃到现代带来的美食，丰富菜品，个个吃得满嘴流油！
她吃饱喝足后，回了现代一趟。
落地后，手机收到了罗领导的短信留言。
“苜苜啊，战承胤和我说，占时不动齐国都城！”
“小器灵的随时注意齐国都城的动向！”
“君主和几个系统还没找到，万一他们抱着同归于尽的想法，大家能及时撤离！”
“我听说世界树正遭遇毁灭性的打击？”
“那棵树能产出超过咱们这个时代的科技产品，若是毁坏了，太可惜了！”
“咱们得弄懂它如何穿越各个位面……许多超级科技我们还要学习！”
叶苜苜连忙回复罗领导，“您不用担心，世界树半死不活的状态了！”
火明显是小器灵放的，它若是不想让火熄灭，就灭不掉。
如今世界树命脉捏在小器灵手里。
小器灵让它生，它就生。
小器灵让它死，它就死。
若它愿意认小器灵为主，能迅速恢复伤势，能力会更上一层楼。
可世界树不那么想，从始至终把小器灵当敌人对待。
content_en:
Lu Xi sat aside and drank the soup quietly. After finishing the soup, he walked out of the capsule and looked at Li Xiao's two index fingers, typing like a chicken.
My typing speed is very slow, and I have to find five radicals for each word I type.
He placed Tang Hengdao on Li Xiao's desk and said in a cold voice: "Your typing speed is too slow. I will help you register for the exchange of supplies!"
Li Xiao looked back at Lu Xi, the young man holding a knife next to the god.
"You, can type?"
"Yes!"
"What about typesetting and printing?"
"It's easy!"
Lu Xi's adoptive father and mother were very interested in him. In addition to hiring private tutors to teach him physical education, they also re-taught the middle and high school courses and provided one-to-one teaching.
He has his own computer, printer...
These were nothing new to him.
Li Xiao gave up his seat, and Lu Xi sat down, pressing the document record book and recording it quickly.
He didn't need to look at the keyboard, the words just clicked out.
The speed is several times that of Li Xiao.
Li Xiao saw that he could operate more efficiently than himself, so he simply let him do it.
Seeing this scene, Ye Clover withdrew his gaze.
I originally thought there would be a nightmare showdown, but I didn't expect the capital of Qi to be captured so easily. It felt like a dream!
Ye Clover called all the soldiers on duty on the rooftop to come over and eat together.
Ye Clover didn't eat much. After eating half a bowl, he gave the table to the soldiers.
It’s rare for everyone to eat modern delicacies, rich dishes, and everyone’s mouth is full of oil!
After she had eaten and drank enough, she returned to modern times.
After landing, my phone received a text message from Leader Luo.
"Alfalfa, Zhan Chengyin told me that we can't move the capital of Qi for a while!"
"Young masters should pay attention to the movements in the capital of Qi at all times!"
"The monarch and several systems have not been found yet. If they want to die together, everyone can evacuate in time!"
"I heard that World Tree is suffering a devastating blow?"
"That tree can produce technological products that exceed those of our time. It would be a pity if it was destroyed!"
"We have to understand how it travels through various planes... We still have to learn a lot of super technologies!"
Ye Clover quickly replied to Leader Luo, "Don't worry, the World Tree is half dead!"
The fire was obviously set by a small spirit. If it didn't want the fire to go out, it couldn't put it out.
Now the lifeblood of the world tree is in the hands of Xiaoqi Ling.
If the spirit of the small instrument allows it to be born, it will be born.
If the little weapon spirit lets it die, it will die.
If it is willing to recognize the small weapon spirit as its master, it can quickly recover from injuries, and its ability will be improved to a higher level.
But World Tree didn't think so, and treated the small weapon spirit as an enemy from beginning to end.
